title: German Mushroom Terrine
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring sautéed mushrooms in a creamy terrine. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Cut the German bread into 1-inch cubes.
In a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat.
Add the cubed bread and cook until lightly toasted, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the skillet and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the creamy terrine until well combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional terrine.
Dot the top with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the terrine is heated through and the top is golden brown.
Garnish with fresh parsley before serving.
